jobs.description: Computational Immunologist - Omics Data, Analysis & Knowledge Mining (m/f/d)Working at Alden Scientific ImmuneAlden Scientific Immune runs the leading ImmunoINSIGHTS™ autoantibody biomarker discovery and immunological insights platform. In the last year our datagenerating lab scaled production 5x, and we are scaling 10x-100x over the next 24 months to meet demand.As the measurement arm of Alden Scientific, we generate the high-quality immune data that feeds directly into Alden Scientific’s computational biology, AI modeling and clinical research platform.Alden Scientific is a global physiology AI company transforming health and longevity by focusing on individuals, not averages. By combining multi-omic data with AI, it delivers predictive, personalized health management - making proactive health the new normal.This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing and well-funded German biotechnology leader. We’re looking for a computational data analyst with a strong background in immunology who turns large autoantibody and high-throughput multi-omic datasets into validated, biologically meaningful answers. You retrieve the data you need directly from our databases, develop and run analyses at scale, and decide whether a dataset is scientifically sound before it is used.This role is based at our laboratory in Dortmund, Germany. Working next to the bench is part of the job: judging noise, latent process variables and data quality means knowing how the data was generated, and unexpected results are best checked with the people who produced them.What You’ll Do - jobs.description: About GF  GlobalFoundries® Inc. (GF®) is one of the world's leading semiconductor manufacturers. GF redefines innovation and semiconductor manufacturing by developing and delivering feature-rich process technology solutions with leading performance in all growth markets. GF offers a unique mix of design, development and manufacturing services. With a talented and diverse team and manufacturing locations in the U.S., Europe and Asia, GF is a trusted technology provider to its global customers. GF employs approximately 15,000 people, including more than 3,000 in Dresden, Germany.For more information, visit hier .Introduction  As Expansion Project Coordinator, you will hold a strategic procurement role focused on securing a competitive supply of manufacturing equipment and services for GlobalFoundries’ Dresden operations. You will collaborate closely with Operations to define requirements and with the broader Global Supply Management team to leverage the global supply base, commercial expertise, technical knowledge, and best practices. A key focus of this position is equipment-related capital expenditure (CAPEX), particularly the coordination and execution of our fab expansion sourcing activities to support timely, competitive, and well-aligned procurement decisions. Your Job  - Coordinate procurement workstreams across the Equipment Commodity team and fab-expansion stakeholders, including Finance, Planning, Engineering and Facility. - Develop and execute sourcing strategies for CAPEX equipment and services in alignment with expansion milestones, budgets, and global commodity objectives. - Serve as the primary commercial interface with equipment suppliers, driving capacity commitments, delivery schedules, technical alignment, and supplier development. - Lead local commercial negotiations and support global negotiations for equipment purchases, installation services, warranties, and long-term support agreements. - Use strategic sourcing and analytical tools—including Power BI, cleansheeting, and negotiation planners—to evaluate costs, track commitments, and support investment decisions. - Identify and mitigate commercial, supply, schedule, and capacity risks that could affect fab-expansion milestones. - Resolve project-specific supply issues in collaboration with Operations, Industrial Engineering, and other key stakeholders. - Manage contractual agreements, change orders, claims, and renegotiate project-specific commercial and technical objectives. - Monitor and communicate sourcing progress, savings, risks, supplier commitments, and key decisions to project leadership and relevant stakeholders. - Ensure all procurement activities support applicable Environmental, Health, Safety, Security, and regulatory requirements throughout the expansion project. Required Qualifications- Bachelor's/Master's Degree in Engineering, Science, Business Administration and/or relevant field of study - Minimum of 2 years relevant work experience in an industrial environment - Good command of English and German, both written and verbal (C1)- Good organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a structured manner- Ability and willingness to travel internationally including Singapore and USA from time to time  Preferred Qualifications- Knowledge of materials and/or their application in semiconductor manufacturing, quality requirements and related supply base - Proficiency in sourcing related skills including sourcing strategy development and execution, contract management and supplier performance management - Ability to lead projects and cross-functional teams - Experience in a semiconductor environment or related industryWe Offer  The position is limited for 2 years and to be filled as soon as possible.Attractive compensation components:   13th month salary, bonus payments, assistance with relocation to Dresden.  Flexible working time arrangements:   Family friendly part-time models, trust flextime, salary conversion into free time.Diverse opportunities for further development:   Career stages for every job, internal qualification offers, promotion of external educational qualifications.Focus on your health:   On-site gym and beach volleyball court, bike leasing, subsidized employee restaurant.Corporate culture:   Cooperation at eye level - everyone is on first name terms with us, budget for individual team events, social commitment via GlobalGives.Diversity is part of our corporate DNA. For this reason, we would like to encourage women in particular to apply for a job with us. As we value equal opportunities and inclusion is particularly important to us, we welcome applications from people with disabilities.The job advertisement refers up to pay grade ENG/IC2 at GlobalFoundries ETV.Information about our benefits you can find here: hierSchlagworte: CHIP,Englisch, EmpfehlungsbundQuelle/Bewerbung via: https://www.empfehlungsbund.de/jobs/308354/expansion-project-coordinator-global-supply-management (https://www.empfehlungsbund.de/jobs/308354/expansion-project-coordinator-global-supply-management#apply_form)Kurzinfo zum UnternehmenÜber GFGlobalFoundries (GF) ist ein führender Hersteller von Halbleitern, auf die sich die Welt zum Leben, Arbeiten und Vernetzen verlässt. jobs.occupation: Research Associate / PostDoc (m/f/x) (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Technische Informatik; Software-Engineering; Künstliche Intelligenz; InformationswissenschaftStellenbeschreibung:As part of the German government's artificial intelligence (AI) strategy, the successful Saxon competence center ScaDS.AI Dresden/Leipzig (Center for Scalable Data Analytics and Artificial Intelligence) is being expanded into a leading German AI competence center for Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (AI). For TUD Dresden University of Technology, diversity is an essential feature and a quality criterion of an excellent university. Accordingly, we welcome all applicants who would like to commit themselves, their achievements and productivity to the success of the whole institution.At the Center for Interdisciplinary Digital Sciences (CIDS), the Department for Scalable Data Analytics and Artificial Intelligence (ScaDS.AI Dresden) offers, subject to the availability of resources, two project positions funded by the BMFTR asResearch Associate / PostDoc (m/f/x)(subject to personal qualification, employees are remunerated according to salary group E 13 TV-L)starting as soon as possible. The positions are fixed-term until March 31, 2029. The individual contract duration will be determined according to the candidate’s qualifications and the intended academic qualification goal. An extension may be possible subject to the availability of resources. The period of employment is governed by § 2 (2) Fixed Term Research Contracts Act (Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz - WissZeitVG). A shorter contract term is possible by arrangement. Within the project Neuro-Symbolic AI with Logic-Memory Decomposition (Neuro-SAIL), a new class of architectures for verifiable neuro-symbolic AI is being researched using Logic-Memory Decomposition. Rule-based decisions are made by logic components, while memory modules are only used when information is incomplete or ambiguous. If no reliable decision is possible, escalation to humans occurs. The aim is to make rule-based decisions more transparent and efficient, to limit the use of neural models to necessary cases, and to reduce rule violations and unsubstantiated statements.Professional assignment: Chair of Scalable Software Architectures for Data Analytics (Prof. Dr. Michael Färber)Research areas: Natural Language Processing, Large Language Models, Knowledge Graphs, and related fields (e.g., Graph Machine Learning)Tasks: - scientific research and development activities in at least one of the above-mentioned research areas- participation in national and international research projects, possibly in collaboration with industry- preparation of publications in internationally renowned journals and presentation of research findings at conferencesRequirements: - a university degree (M.Sc., M.Eng. or equivalent) and if applicable a PhD degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Intelligent Systems, Data Science, Computational Science, Mathematics, Applied Statistics, Information Science, Information Systems, Information Systems Engineering, Electronic Information Engineering, Computational Linguistics, Digital Humanities, Linguistics, or a related field- a strong interest in fundamental research in the above-mentioned fields- strong programming skills, preferably in Python, including experience with deep learning frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, TensorFlow) and related tools- good written and spoken English- strong analytical and problem-solving skills- high level of motivation and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team- research experience (publications, theses, projects) in the above-mentioned research areas is a major advantageWe offer:The position comes with access to high-performance computing resources and access to training opportunities within ScaDS.AI.TUD strives to employ more women in academia and research. We therefore expressly encourage women to apply. The university is a family-friendly university. We welcome applications from candidates with disabilities. If multiple candidates prove to be equally qualified, those with disabilities or with equivalent status pursuant to the German Social Code IX (SGB IX) will receive priority for employment.Application:Please submit your detailed application with the usual documents (e.g., cover letter, CV, and other supporting documents), quoting the job reference “ScaDS.AI Färber E 13” by November, 25, 2026 (stamped arrival date of the university central mail service or the time stamp on the email server of TUD applies), preferably via the TUD SecureMail Portal https://securemail.tu-dresden.de by sending it as a single pdf file to jobs-scads.ai@tu-dresden.de (https://mailto:jobs-scads.ai@tu-dresden.de) or to:TU Dresden, ScaDS.AI, Prof. Dr. Michael Färber, Helmholtzstr. 10, 01069 Dresden, Germany.Please submit copies only, as your application will not be returned to you. Expenses incurred in attending interviews cannot be reimbursed.TUD is a founding partner in the DRESDEN-concept alliance.Reference to data protection: Your data protection rights, the purpose for which your data will be processed, as well as further information about data protection is available to you on the website:https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis (https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis) .Ergänzende Informationen:Nur schwerbehinderte oder ihnen gleichgestellte PersonenAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Data Science, Forschung, Entwicklung, Informationswissenschaften, Mathematik, Informatik, Technische Informatik
